updates.new_facts: Grace retires at S3 end with Vanguard and chooses rest. She later returns in S5 to go to the girls' side against Alter David as a stabilizer, choosing judgment with compassion.
updates.quote: Grace retiring at S3 end (with Vanguard) This is actually very strong writing. Why it works: Grace’s arc was never about endless escalation She started as a healer → became a judge → chooses rest Her retirement says: power does not own me

updates.new_facts: Nilanjona takes guardianship in S4 continuing her lineage and later returns in S5 to help against Niharo when guardians respond to existential threats.
updates.quote: Nilanjona taking guardianship in S4 This is also clean and culturally grounded. Why it works: She isn’t “quitting” — she’s continuing lineage Her mother’s role matters now It closes her personal loop without killing her

updates.new_facts: Arzuna shifts from villain to an anti-hero with a vanishing presence, making short appearances in S4, killing Maliha out of mercy wrapped in brutality, and returning after Yoshiko's death as the executioner of inevitability.
updates.quote: Villain → anti-hero → vanishing presence This is risky territory — but you’re handling it right. Why it works: Arzuna was never pure evil She was corrupted but conscious Vanishing keeps her unpredictable

updates.new_facts: Maliha knowingly and willingly joins Alter David despite knowing he is wrong, proving that love can damn you, and is eventually killed by Arzuna.
updates.quote: Maliha knows Alter David is wrong She joins anyway Love overrides morality That’s not villainy. That’s human weakness taken to its extreme.

updates.new_facts: Yoshiko dies, breaking Nyxia, permanently shifting the S5 tone, and signaling that no one is safe.
updates.quote: Yoshiko’s death: Breaks Nyxia Shifts S5 tone permanently Signals “no one is safe” Arzuna appearing after that: Prevents collapse Replaces rage with action

updates.new_facts: Nyxia learns control without losing mercy, learns that vengeance does not equal justice after Yoshiko's death, and experiences psychological state changes.
updates.quote: Nyxia learns control without mercy loss Grace chooses judgment with compassion Arzuna chooses action without forgiveness

updates.new_facts: Ethan learns to accept darkness without becoming it in S5.
updates.quote: Ethan learns to accept darkness without becoming it
